fileName.description: Untrusted: receivers keep only the last path segment

resumable.description: Sender waits for file.resume before sending chunks (peer advertised files.resume). Omitted when false.

relativePath.description: Folder transfers: the file's folder, '/'-separated, starting with the batch's top folder name; no file name. Untrusted.

batchId.description: Folder transfers: groups the files of one folder.
